            <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/PPthoughts/p/20120865" title="发布于 2026-05-22 16:02">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【硬核脑洞】16位实模式最后的疯狂：我们能否在 640KB 常规内存里手搓一个 MD 模拟器？</span>
    

</a>

        </h2>
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<blockquote>
<p>引言：一场跨越时空的硬件豪赌</p>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIBhAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">如果在 2026 年的今天，有人告诉你他想写一个世嘉 Mega Drive (MD/Genesis) 模拟器，你大概率会推荐他用 C++ 20、Rust 或者哪怕是 Python，跑在 64 位的现代操作系统上。</div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIBxAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">但如果我把底牌抽走，给你套上最沉重的历史枷锁呢？</div>
<ul class="KsbFXc U6u95" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">
<li class="Z1qcYe" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAICBAA" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">操作系统：MS-DOS 6.22</span></span></li>
<li class="Z1qcYe" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAICBAB" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">编译器：Turbo C 3.0 (TC3)</span></span></li>
<li class="Z1qcYe" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAICBAC" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">内存上限：<span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">640KB 常规内存（绝不使用 XMS/EMS 扩展内存）</span></span></span></li>
<li class="Z1qcYe" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAICBAD" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">运行环境：实模式（Real Mode），没有 32 位保护模式的庇护</span></span></li>
</ul>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAICRAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">在大多数现代程序员眼里，这无异于自杀。MD 的游戏卡带（ROM）动辄 1MB 到 4MB，而你的物理内存上限只有 640KB，甚至连一张卡带的四分之一都装不下！更不用说，你还要在里面塞进 16 位小端序的 PC 代码、去模拟 16 位大端序的 Motorola 68000 和 8 位的 Z80 双处理器，同时还得压榨出每秒 60 帧的画面。</div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIChAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">这真的可能吗？</div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAICxAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">今天，我们要抛开所有的思维定势，来一场基于计算机底层原理的<span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">极限大猜想。</span></div>
</blockquote>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAICxAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">&nbsp;<img alt="X" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/149990/202605/149990-20260522160043520-986520297.png" class="lazyload"></div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAICxAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">
<h3 class="otQkpb" data-sfc-root="c" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin: 24px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">猜想一：640KB 装不下几兆的 ROM？那就把文件指针当成 CPU 的总线！</h3>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIDRAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">开发模拟器，大家的第一反应往往是：<code class="KDcb0c" dir="ltr" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0.888889px solid rgb(240, 242, 245);">fopen</code> 打开 ROM ──&gt; <code class="KDcb0c" dir="ltr" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0.888889px solid rgb(240, 242, 245);">malloc</code> 申请几兆内存 ──&gt; <code class="KDcb0c" dir="ltr" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0.888889px solid rgb(240, 242, 245);">fread</code> 一把全塞进去。但在 16 位实模式下，<code class="KDcb0c" dir="ltr" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0.888889px solid rgb(240, 242, 245);">malloc</code> 最大只能给你 64KB 的段（Segment）。</div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIDhAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">疯子的解法：如果内存装不下，我们为什么非要装下它？</span></div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIDxAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">让我们把思维逆转过来。在真实的世嘉 MD 主机里，主 CPU (M68K) 的引脚是直接焊接在卡带插槽上的。当 CPU 需要读取下一条指令时，它通过地址线发射电信号，卡带芯片瞬间返回数据。</div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIEBAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">在 DOS 环境下，我们难道不能把 <span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">RAM Disk（内存盘）里的 ROM 文件 当成那块物理卡带吗？</span></div>
<ul class="KsbFXc U6u95" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">
<li class="Z1qcYe" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIERAA" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">我们的模拟器 PC 指针，不再是一个实模式的内存地址，而是一个 <code class="KDcb0c" dir="ltr" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0.888889px solid rgb(240, 242, 245);">unsigned long</code> 类型的<span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">文件偏移量。</span></span></li>
<li class="Z1qcYe" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIERAB" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">每当 M68K 的指令指针（PC）向前移动，我们就调用 <code class="KDcb0c" dir="ltr" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0.888889px solid rgb(240, 242, 245);">fseek</code> 和 <code class="KDcb0c" dir="ltr" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0.888889px solid rgb(240, 242, 245);">fread</code>，去 RAM Disk 里临时抠出 2 个字节的机器码。</span></li>
</ul>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIExAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"></span></div>
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"></div>
<hr class="j3tEEe" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-pl="|[]" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 32px 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(128, 128, 128);">
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"></div>
<h3 class="otQkpb" data-sfc-root="c" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin: 24px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">猜想二：“滑动窗口”降维打击 ── 徒手造一个 MMU</h3>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIFRAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">既然每次读文件太慢，全读进去又没地方放，那我们就实现一个<span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">软分段（Segmentation）机制。</span></div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIFhAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">在 640KB 的常规内存里，我们牙缝里挤出 64KB，开辟一个 <code class="KDcb0c" dir="ltr" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0.888889px solid rgb(240, 242, 245);">far</code> 数组缓冲区。</div>
<ul class="KsbFXc U6u95" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">
<li class="Z1qcYe" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIFxAA" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">这个 64KB 的缓冲区，就是我们观察 4MB 卡带的“视口”。</span></li>
<li class="Z1qcYe" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIFxAB" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">当 M68K 的逻辑 PC 指针在这个 64KB 范围内活动时，我们的模拟器<span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">直接在内存里指针寻址，速度快如闪电！</span></span></li>
<li class="Z1qcYe" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIFxAC" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">只有当《索尼克》打赢了 Boss，发生远距离代码跳转（JMP），PC 指针飞出了这 64KB 边界时，我们才触发一次“缺页异常” ── 刹车、移动文件指针、用 RAM Disk 重新填满这 64KB 缓冲区。</span></li>
</ul>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIGBAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">看！我们没有使用任何保护模式的硬件支持，却用纯 C 语言逻辑，在 16 位实模式里模拟出了现代 CPU 赖以生存的 <span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">MMU（内存管理单元） 核心思想。</span></div>
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"></div>
<hr class="j3tEEe" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-pl="|[]" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 32px 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(128, 128, 128);">
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"></div>
<h3 class="otQkpb" data-sfc-root="c" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin: 24px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">猜想三：大端序与小端序的“迎头痛击”</h3>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIGhAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">解决了卡带加载，紧接着就是硬件底层不可调和的矛盾：</div>
<ul class="KsbFXc U6u95" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">
<li class="Z1qcYe" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIGxAA" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">MD 的 M68000 是<span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">大端序（Big-Endian）：高位字节在前，低位字节在后。</span></span></li>
<li class="Z1qcYe" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIGxAB" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">PC 的 8086/Pentium 是<span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">小端序（Little-Endian）：低位字节在前，高位字节在后。</span></span></li>
</ul>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIHBAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">这意味着，如果我们从卡带读取一条指令 <code class="KDcb0c" dir="ltr" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0.888889px solid rgb(240, 242, 245);">0x4E75</code>（M68K 的 RTS 返回指令），直接存入 PC 内存，PC 的 CPU 会把它理解成 <code class="KDcb0c" dir="ltr" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0.888889px solid rgb(240, 242, 245);">0x754E</code> ── 逻辑瞬间崩溃。</div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIHRAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">如果我们在每读取一个字（Word）的时候都去用 C 语言做位移转换：<code class="KDcb0c" dir="ltr" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0.888889px solid rgb(240, 242, 245);"><strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">(data &gt;&gt; 8) | (data &lt;&lt; 8)</span></strong></code>，Pentium 处理器那可怜的流水线会被这种无效的算术运算彻底挤爆。</div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIHhAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">我们要搞就搞极致的：<br data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-pl="|[]" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">在“滑动窗口”从 RAM Disk 读取 64KB 数据进内存的瞬间，直接用一段内联汇编，调用 8086 的硬件绝活 ── <code class="KDcb0c" dir="ltr" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0.888889px solid rgb(240, 242, 245);">XCHG AH, AL</code>。<br data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-pl="|[]" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">一个循环，在一瞬间把整个 64KB 缓冲区的字节两两对调。这样，后续的指令解码器在读取数据时，就可以直接享受“免转换”的本地速度。</span></div>
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"></div>
<hr class="j3tEEe" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-pl="|[]" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 32px 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(128, 128, 128);">
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"></div>
<div class="otQkpb" data-animation-nesting="" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin: 24px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">
<h3 class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-root="c" data-hveid="CAAIBhAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">猜想四：在单任务 DOS 中编织双处理器的时间线</span></h3>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIBxAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">世嘉 MD 内部是一套非常奇葩的“双 CPU 主从架构”：主 CPU 是一代神芯 Motorola 68000，副 CPU 则是从上个世代（红白机、SMS 时代）退役下来的 8 位老将 Z80。</div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAICBAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">说白了，MD 的日常就是：大哥 M68K 在前面疯狂跑游戏程序、拼命渲染画面，把小弟 Z80 死死按在椅子上吹喇叭（专职负责播放 FM 音乐和音效）。 两个 CPU 的频率比大约是 <span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">2.14 : 1，它们通过一个狭窄的共享内存通道协作。</span></span></div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAICRAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">可是，我们的 MS-DOS 是个不折不扣的“单任务单线程”系统，既没有现代操作系统的多线程（Pthread）并发，更不懂得什么叫并行。我们要在只有单核的 PC 上，怎么同时还原“大哥冲锋、小弟吹喇叭”的场面，还不让声音和画面卡顿？</div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIChAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">答案是：我们只能化身为“微观时间的主宰”，把它们俩按在同一个时间线上轮流摩擦。</span></div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAICxAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="T286Pc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">既然不能并行，那我们就用<span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">时钟周期计数器（Cycle Counter）把时间切成碎屑。<br data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-pl="|[]" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">游戏画面的一帧，在硬件上是由 262 条扫描线（Scanline）构成的。每一条扫描线，正好对应大哥 M68K 执行 488 个时钟周期。<br data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-pl="|[]" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">那我们就写一个密不透风的大循环：</span></span></div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAICxAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (line = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; line &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">262</span>; line++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
    execute_m68k(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">488</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 强制让大哥 M68K 跑 488 个周期，算完这一行的画面</span>
    execute_z80(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">228</span>);  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 按照频率比例，强制把 Z80 戳醒，让它吹 228 个周期的喇叭</span>
    render_scanline(line); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 顺手把这一行的 VGA 图形吐到 PC 显存里</span>
}</pre>
</div>
<p>两个处理器在我们的微观调度下，就像拉锯一样交替向前推进时间。在宏观上看，声音和画面就达成了完美的同步，读者在 DOSBox 里听到的《索尼克》BGM 也就绝不会变调！</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAICxAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIJRAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"></div>
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"></div>
<hr class="j3tEEe" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-pl="|[]" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-sae="" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 32px 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(128, 128, 128);">
<div class="Fsg96" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"></div>
<h3 class="otQkpb" data-sfc-root="c" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin: 24px 0px 12px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">结语：这是一场致敬，也是一次底层的突围</h3>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIJxAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">这场猜想可行吗？逻辑上，它完全闭环；技术上，它退无可退。</div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIKBAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">我们放弃了现代操作系统提供的几吉字节（GB）的虚拟内存，放弃了高级编译器的自动优化，退回到了 1990 年代初那个只有 640KB 常规内存的荒凉世界。但正是这种极端的限制，逼着我们去思考：<span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">什么是地址总线？什么是内存映射？如何用纯粹的算法逻辑，去跨越硬件代差的鸿沟？</span></div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIKRAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">这个极限挑战项目我已经正式立项。接下来，我将尝试在 DOSBox 和 TC3 环境下，敲下这个“16位实模式 MD 模拟器”的第一行代码。</div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIKhAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);"><span class="Yjhzub" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">你觉得这个近乎疯狂的方案，会在哪一个环节率先翻车？是 M68K 变长指令集的解码地狱，还是 VGA Mode 13h 的显存吞吐瓶颈？</span></div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAIKxAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">欢迎在评论区留下你的毒奶和见解。下一期，我们将正式解剖《索尼克 1》的 ROM Header，看看游戏是如何在我们手搓的虚拟空间里睁开第一双眼睛的！</div>
</div>
<div class="n6owBd awi2gc" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="c" data-sfc-cb="" data-hveid="CAAICxAA" data-complete="true" data-processed="true" data-copy-service-computed-style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; margin: 12px 0px 16px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 0px rgb(10, 10, 10);">&nbsp;</div>
